messages.content: Violetta wants to buy new crayons. She needs them in 5 different colors and prepared $20 for this purchase. One crayon costs $2. How much change will she get?

content.text:
Violetta buys 5 crayons at $2 each: 5 × $2 = $10

Change: $20 − $10 = **$10**
